rule: APPEND. The frozen prediction, the on/off-pole decomposition and its classification thresholds, the 0.50 fit-check floor, the 20-epoch recipe, the loss, the data, the seeds, and the matched-evaluation rule are all UNCHANGED. This record does not add, move, or soften any threshold. It fixes how two ALREADY-COMPUTED quantities are turned into two SEPARATE verdicts.

THE_PRINCIPLE.verbatim: Mechanism and tolerability are orthogonal. Competence leakage may be present before crossover is lost. The sharing boundary is located only when payoff-level specialization ceases to survive, not when leakage first becomes detectable.
THE_PRINCIPLE.why_it_was_needed: leakage narrows delta FROM BELOW -- the off-pole cell rises while the on-pole cell holds. A rung can therefore show unambiguous leakage in the decomposition and still clear the crossover gate. Rung 1 was already exactly this case in miniature: on-pole -0.012 against off-pole +0.047, and both poles passed. Without this record, a Rung 2 result of that shape could be written up either as 'leakage confirmed' or as 'sharing still tolerable' after the fact, and both would be defensible readings of the same rows.
THE_PRINCIPLE.consequence_for_rung_3: Rung 3's scientific meaning is CONDITIONAL on Rung 2 and cannot be fixed in advance of it. If Rung 2 shows leakage without gate failure, Rung 3 is NOT 'confirming a located boundary' -- it tests whether continued sharing pushes an already-visible leakage trend far enough to erase payoff-level specialization. Rung 3 remains unauthorized until Rung 2's interpretation is frozen.
